title: Can Claude replace When I Work? 20/20 checks, 84 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a When I Work alternative, a shift scheduler with a weekly schedule built in draft and published as a whole, conflict checks on every assignment, open shifts, swaps and drops approved by a manager, and labor cost before publishing, from one written spec: all 20 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 84 gaps in the spec.

The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/shift-scheduling
When I Work pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/when-i-work

When I Work prices: $2.50 per user per month for a single location or schedule, $5 per user per month for multiple locations or schedules; Enterprise by contact (wheniwork.com/pricing, October 2026). For a cafe with 20 staff on the single-location plan that is $600 a year.

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
